metadata.title: T28 Q29-Q35 Determinism Validation - Quick Reference Card
metadata.purpose: Rapid reference for testing deterministic behavior in capsule compositions
metadata.scope: Bitwise reproducibility, execution path determinism, generation counter monotonicity, cache coherence, memory ordering, deterministic replay, multi-tier composition

tier-overview.description: Tier 5: Determinism Validation (Q29-Q35) addresses critical gaps in T28 testing framework by validating that atomic capsules produce reproducible results, execution paths are deterministic, and multi-tier compositions preserve deterministic behavior.

quick-win-roadmap.win: 10 generation counter tests (5 per-capsule monotonicity, 5 cross-capsule ordering, wraparound safety)
5 cache coherence tests (false sharing detection, alignment verification, perfcnt validation)
3 memory ordering tests (Acquire/Release fence, SeqCst total order, ABA prevention)

question.name: Execution Path Determinism
question.focus: Same input → same execution path (recorded via kdb trace replay)

question.name: Bitwise Reproducibility
question.focus: Output bytes match exactly across runs (SIMD, fixed-point, float)
question.test-pattern: for 100 runs: output = compute(fixed_input); assert!(output == baseline)
question.success-criterion: All 100 runs produce identical bit patterns

question.name: Generation Counter Monotonicity
question.focus: Cross-capsule ordering, wraparound safety, monotonic increments under concurrency
question.test-pattern: 100 capsules × 10K increments → collect generations → verify unique + ordered
question.success-criterion: Zero duplicates, zero gaps, monotonic across capsules

question.name: Cache Coherence Determinism
question.focus: Alignment effectiveness, false sharing detection via perfcnt, cache line contention
question.estimated-tests: 5 tests (alignment verification, contention measurement, false sharing test)

question.name: Memory Ordering Consistency
question.focus: Acquire/Release fence, SeqCst total order, ABA prevention, reordering detection
question.success-criterion: All fences prevent reordering, total order verified, ABA impossible
question.estimated-tests: 3-5 tests (fence effectiveness, total order, ABA prevention)

question.name: Deterministic Replay
question.focus: kdb snapshot → replay → identical state, backward/forward replay, time-travel capability
question.test-pattern: trace = record(input); replayed = replay(trace); assert_eq!(trace.final_state, replayed.final_state)
question.success-criterion: Replay matches original, forward and backward both work

question.name: Composition Determinism
question.focus: T1+T2+T3 compositions maintain determinism, metacapsule orchestration, no emergent nondeterminism
question.test-pattern: test_t6_mixed_determinism { for input in test_inputs { verify!(compute_t6(input) == expected) } }
question.success-criterion: 100+ runs with identical output for all tier combinations
question.estimated-tests: 5-7 tests (T1 alone, T1+T2, T1+T2+T3, T6 metacapsule, error paths)

pattern.title: Q29: Execution Path Determinism Pattern
pattern.description: Record execution trace, replay, compare instruction addresses and opcodes

pattern.title: Q30: Bitwise Reproducibility Pattern
Q31: Generation Counter Monotonicity Pattern
pattern.description: 100 capsules × 10K increments, verify no duplicates and ordering

pattern.title: Q32: Cache Coherence Pattern
pattern.description: Verify 64B alignment, measure cache misses with perfcnt

pattern.title: Q33: Memory Ordering Pattern
Q34: Deterministic Replay Pattern
pattern.description: Snapshot state, replay execution, verify identical outcome

pattern.title: Q35: Composition Determinism Pattern
pattern.description: Test T1+T2+T3 tiers combined maintain determinism

win.title: 10 Generation Counter Tests (5h effort)

includes.test: 1 global ordering (sort by timestamp, verify monotonic)
1 zero initialization (verify gen starts at 1, not 0)
1 comparison with baseline (verify consistent across runs)

win.commands:
# Run Q31 tests cargo test --lib test_t28_q31 -- --test-threads=1
# Measure performance cargo bench --bench generation_counter_bench
# Check coverage cargo tarpaulin --lib --out Html

win.title: 5 Cache Coherence Tests (4h effort)

includes.test: 1 false sharing test (hammer atomic1, measure atomic2 contention)
1 multi-core contention (16 threads on same/different cache lines)

win.commands:
# Run Q32 tests cargo test --lib test_t28_q32 -- --test-threads=1
# Benchmark with perfcnt cargo bench --bench cache_coherence_bench
# Verify alignment on target cargo run --bin align_check

win.title: 3 Memory Ordering Tests (3h effort)

includes.test: 1 SeqCst total order (all threads observe same order)

win.commands:
# Run Q33 tests cargo test --lib test_t28_q33 -- --test-threads=1
# Run with loom (model checker) cargo test --lib test_t28_q33 --features loom
# Stress test (1M operations) cargo test --lib test_aba_prevention -- --nocapture --test-threads=1

command.name: Run all Q29-Q35 tests
command.desc: Execute all determinism tier tests with verbose output
command.usage: cargo test --lib \ test_t28_q29 \ test_t28_q30 \ test_t28_q31 \ test_t28_q32 \ test_t28_q33 \ test_t28_q34 \ test_t28_q35 \ -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture

command.desc: Run quick-win roadmap tests in priority order

command.name: Comprehensive validation (production)
command.desc: Full suite with B32 benchmarking and kdb integration
command.usage:
# Step 1: Run all tests cargo test --all-features
# Step 2: Run B32 benchmarks (1000+ iterations) cargo bench --lib
# Step 3: Run with kdb tracer (requires kdb installed) KDB_TRACE=1 cargo test --lib test_t28_q29 test_t28_q34
# Step 4: Generate coverage report cargo tarpaulin --out Html --output-dir coverage/
# Step 5: Verify completion ./scripts/verify-t28-determinism.sh

framework-references.framework: Performance benchmarking (95% CI, 1000+ iterations, validate determinism claims)
Unsafe code validation (ensure assumptions hold for deterministic behavior)
Integration testing (verify composed systems maintain determinism)
Time-travel debugger (record/replay execution traces for Q29, Q34)

anti-pattern.name: Timing-dependent assertions
anti-pattern.description: Tests fail intermittently due to sleep/timing, defeating determinism validation
anti-pattern.solution: Use kdb recording instead, verify instruction-level determinism, not timing

anti-pattern.name: Floating-point comparison without tolerance
anti-pattern.description: SIMD results differ slightly (1-2 ULP), test fails requiring tolerance
anti-pattern.solution: Use fixed-point or canonical float libraries, validate bitwise equality, architecture-specific

anti-pattern.name: Generation counter test with only 1 capsule
anti-pattern.description: Doesn't catch cross-capsule ordering issues, only validates per-capsule monotonicity
anti-pattern.solution: Test with 100+ capsules, 10K+ increments, verify global ordering via HashSet

anti-pattern.name: Cache coherence test without perfcnt validation
anti-pattern.description: Assumes alignment works without measuring cache misses
anti-pattern.solution: Use perfcnt library, measure <5% cache miss rate, validate on target hardware

anti-pattern.name: Memory ordering test in release mode only
anti-pattern.description: Misses reordering issues visible in debug mode or under -O2
anti-pattern.solution: Test with both debug and release builds, use loom for exhaustive interleaving
